author: GamingBolt
description:
Boomer shooters are already a gloriously uncomplicated experience. Breakneck speed, pixelated viscera, and an arsenal of awestriking armaments characterise the slate of modern first-person shooters which look to the past for inspiration. 

Throw in an Ultramarine, as per the first Boltgun, and you had one of the most memorable boomers in recent years. For the sequel, developer Auroch Digital is taking the foundation of its predecessor but ramping up the bloodshed with a second playable character, a gauntlet of new enemies, an expansive campaign, and a glut of newly devastating firepower. The mechanics demands more blood, and Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 is set to deliver. Here’s fifteen things you need to know.
title: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2: 15 Things You Need To Know Before You Buy

author: GamingBolt
description:
The Metro franchise needs no introduction in modern gaming, and it's been in the spotlight quite a lot recently thanks to Metro 2039 looming ever larger on the horizon. It's probably a great thing that Deep Silver and 4A Games decided to release a next-gen update for Metro 2033 Redux and Metro: Last Light Redux, both of which were excellent remakes/remasters of the games that established the franchise.

If you're thinking about diving into the first two chapters of An Incredible Adventure, or if you're just thinking about diving back into both titles to brush up your knowledge of the story, we thought it was a good idea to put down a few things that we think you should know before you jump in.
title: Metro 2033 And Metro Last Light Redux PS5 And Xbox Series X - 10 Things To Know Before You Buy

author: GamingBolt
description:
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 2026 is returning multiplayer battles to the genre’s roots, and promising more grounded realism, hard-hitting gunplay, and plenty of new ways to customise your playstyle. 

But, this isn’t merely back to basics; there are new movement systems, weapons, progression options, modes, and more to consider before you buy. Here are fifteen of the biggest things you need to know.
title: Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 (2026) Multiplayer - 15 Things You Need To Know Before You Buy
